Functions.Name: GetGraphicsRequirements
Functions.Description: Declares the graphics APIs that the module supports, in preference order. Replaces GetCompatibleFeatureLevels in interface version 2. The host reads these requirements before it creates the module.
Functions.ReturnDescription: Return S_OK after filling the requirements. Return an error code if the requirements cannot be supplied.

Args.Name: requirements
Args.Description: The requirements to fill. Set APICount from 1 to 4. Fill APIs in preference order with MGDF_GRAPHICS_API_D3D11 or MGDF_GRAPHICS_API_D3D12. Set MinFeatureLevel to the minimum D3D feature level. Set MinShaderModel to a D3D_SHADER_MODEL value for D3D12. D3D11 ignores MinShaderModel.

Functions.Name: GetCustomArchiveHandlers
Functions.Description: Allows a module to tell the host if it is going to provide any custom virtual file system handlers.
Functions.ReturnDescription: Should return S_OK if the supplied list is large enough to contain all the items in the list, otherwise return E_FAIL and sets the required size in the length parameter

Args.Name: list
Args.Description: Pointer to a buffer to store the list of provided archive handlers

Args.Name: length
Args.Description: The length of the provided buffer

Args.Name: logger
Args.Description: An interface allowing the archive handler to write to the MGDF logs

Functions.Name: GetModule
Functions.Description: Factory function which returns an instance of the module to the host.
Functions.ReturnDescription: Should return S_OK if the module could be created, otherwise E_FAIL

Args.Name: module
Args.Description: An instance of the module interface
